quotes.text: Leakage expansion: after a single anchor is found, a local scan examines up to 10 events before and after the anchor.

parsed.rationale: Leakage controls exist at the tool and context level (leakage expansion of anchors, role-restricted readviews, prior admissions limited to earlier ones, lab agent returns null for tests not on record). There is no held-out or private split of labels beyond credentialed access, and no canary or provenance marker.
